about: Natural-language versions of the independent expected-answer cases, written by hand. Each entry asks the case's question in plain language; the eval plans it with the real model and compares the result with that case's expectations in answers.json. `context` simulates a follow-up to an earlier question. `accept_outcomes` lists the outcomes that are acceptable when plain-language wording is legitimately open (the fixed tools have no person-centric query).
